title: Battle of Breadfield
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Breadfield", at revision 1370435153, opens: "The Battle of Breadfield was the most tremendous conflict fought in Transylvania up to that time in the Ottoman–Hungarian Wars, taking place on 13 October 1479, on the Breadfield near the Saxon village of Alkenyér next to the river Maros (Mureș). The Hungarian army was led by Pál Kinizsi, István Báthory, Vuk Branković, and Basarab Laiotă cel Bătrân." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q690291, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1479 battle of the Ottoman–Hungarian Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
